Name: Points
Description: Number of points scored

Name: Field Goals Made
Description: Number of field goals that a team has made (both 2 and 3 pointers)

Name: Field Goals Attempted
Description: Number of field goals that a team has attempted (both 2 and 3 pointers)

Name: Field Goal Percentage
Description: Percentage of field goal attempts made

Name: 3 Point Field Goals Made
Description: Number of 3 point field goals made

Name: 3 Point Field Goals Attempted
Description: Number of 3 point field goals attempted

Name: 3 Point Field Goal Percentage
Description: Percentage of 3 point field goal attempts made

Name: Free Throws Made
Description: Number of free throws made

Name: Free Throws Attempted
Description: Number of free throws attempted

Name: Free Throw Percentage
Description: Percentage of free throw attempts made

Name: Offensive Rebounds
Description: Number of rebounds obtained while on offense

Name: Defensive Rebounds
Description: Number of rebounds obtained while on defense

Name: Rebounds
Description: Number of rebounds collected

Name: Assists Made
Description: Number of assists made

Name: Turnovers
Description: Number of times the offensive team loses the ball to the defensive team

Name: Steals
Description: Number of times the defensive team takes the ball from the offensive team, causing a turnover

Name: Blocks
Description: Number of times the offensive team attempts a shot, and the defensive team tips the ball, blocking their chance to score

Name: Personal Fouls
Description: Number of personal fouls committed

Name: Plus-Minus
Description: The point differential when a team is on the floor

Name: Minutes
Description: The number of minutes when a team is on the floor

Name: Offensive Rating
Description: Points scored per 100 possessions

Name: Defensive Rating
Description: Points allowed per 100 possessions

Name: Net Rating
Description: Point differential per 100 possessions (points scored - points allowed per 100 possessions)

Name: Assist Percentage
Description: Percentage of  field goals assisted on

Name: Assist to Turnover Ratio
Description: Number of assists compared to the number of turnovers

Name: Assist Ratio
Description: Number of assists per 100 possessions

Name: Offensive Rebound Percentage
Description: Percentage of available offensive rebounds a team obtains

Name: Defensive Rebound Percentage
Description: Percentage of available defensive rebounds a team obtains

Name: Rebound Percentage
Description: Percentage of available rebounds a team collects

Name: True Shooting Percentage
Description: Shooting percentage that factors in the value of three-point field goals and free throws in addition to two-point field goals

Name: Pace
Description: Number of possesions per 48 minutes

Name: Effective Field Goal Percentage
Description: Field goal percentage adjusting for made 3-point field goals being 1.5 times more valuable than made 2-point field goals

Name: Free Throw Attempt Rate
Description: Number of free throw attempts shot in comparison to the number of field goal attempts shot

Name: Turnover Percentage
Description: Percentage of plays that end in a turnover

Name: Offensive Rebound Percentage
Description: Percentage of available offensive rebounds obtained

Name: Opponent Effective Field Goal Percentage
Description: Opponent's field goal percentage adjusting for made 3-point field goals being 1.5 times more valuable than made 2-point field goals

Name: Opponent Free Throw Attempt Rate
Description: Opponent's number of free throw attempts shot in comparison to the number of field goal attempts shot

Name: Opponent Turnover Percentage
Description: Opponent's percentage of plays that end in a turnover

Name: Opponent Offensive Rebound Percentage
Description: Opponent's percentage of available offensive rebounds obtained

Name: Points Off Turnovers
Description: Number of points scored following an opponent's turnover

Name: Second Chance Points
Description: Percentage of isolation plays where free throws are shot as the result of a shooting foul

Name: Fast Break Points
Description: Number of points scored while on a fast break

Name: Points in the Paint
Description: Number of points scored inside the paint

Name: Opponent Points Off Turnovers
Description: Opponent's number of points scored following an opponent's turnover

Name: Opponent Second Chance Points
Description: Opponent's percentage of isolation plays where free throws are shot as the result of a shooting foul

Name: Opponent Fast Break Points
Description: Opponent's number of points scored while on a fast break

Name: Opponent Points in the Paint
Description: Opponent's number of points scored in the paint

Description: Percentage of field goals attempted that are 2 pointers

Name: Percent of Field Goals Attempted (3 pointers)
Description: Percentage of field goals attempted that are 3 pointers
